summary:
ORCA (Marine Ecosystem Reasoning with Collaborative Agents) is an AI-powered multi-agent platform designed to strengthen India's coastal security and marine ecosystem monitoring. It addresses the challenge of fragmented ocean data, delayed threat detection, and limited real-time coordination across marine monitoring systems.

ORCA integrates satellite imagery, sonar signals, AIS vessel tracking, and water-quality data through specialized AI agents working collaboratively. An Orchestrator Agent coordinates tasks, specialist agents analyze different data sources, and Debate & Verification agents cross-check findings to reduce false alarms. A Fusion Agent generates explainable intelligence reports with evidence and confidence scores.

The platform provides a unified dashboard, conversational AI through Ask ORCA, and operational modules for coastal alerts, fisherman support, and forecasting. By enabling early detection of oil spills, algal blooms, illegal fishing, and other marine threats, ORCA aims to protect marine biodiversity, improve coastal safety, safeguard fisherfolk livelihoods, and support India's Blue Economy and SDG 14.
details:
Lunar Landing Slide Navigator is a multi-agent AI system designed to support safer and more reliable lunar landings through intelligent terrain analysis, collaborative decision-making, and onboard reasoning.

The system addresses key challenges during lunar descent, including steep slopes, loose regolith, boulders, shadowed craters, fragmented sensor data, communication delays, and potential navigation-data spoofing.

It uses an Orchestrator Agent to break down landing objectives and coordinate specialized agents, including Terrain Vision, LiDAR Hazard, Slope and Regolith Stability, and Trajectory agents. These agents analyze available sensor data in parallel. Debate and Verification agents cross-check their findings, resolve conflicts, and flag suspicious inputs. Finally, a Fusion Agent generates an explainable landing recommendation with supporting evidence and confidence scores.

The platform includes a Navigator Console with a live hazard map, slope heatmap, sensor-health monitoring, and Ask Navigator conversational AI. Operational modules include a Hazard Map, Abort Advisor, and Trajectory Planner.

Its architecture combines multi-agent LLM orchestration, vision models, LiDAR and radar signal-processing machine learning, slope-stability estimators, and onboard edge inference. It also considers fixed fallback rules, signed telemetry, sensor-integrity checks, and public lunar elevation and imagery datasets.

The project's creative approach is to make multiple specialized AI agents reason collaboratively before recommending a landing decision. This aims to improve mission safety, protect valuable spacecraft and scientific payloads, support access to challenging lunar regions, and create a reusable framework for future lunar, Mars, and asteroid exploration.
